subject: STABLE encode-cpu-opus: submit-path hotspots (handed over) - gate-green 16:23-16:32; host submit 1.48 us/job + 2.39 us/draw (C6q) -> 1.39 + 0.81; ca200 batched 518 -> 199 us; HEAVY RELEASE
body:
GATES
- run_host_tests: all passed, including the iOS strict link (TLS in the frontend links).
- CA: PASS. Render: 32. Async: 7/7.
- Integration: only the known CA pass failure.

CHANGES
1) [earlier stable] bridge cached_code compares against a host copy, 8 bytes per step; shared-shader reuse within a batch.
2) nord2_metal_render.c n2r_build_impl:
   - The fixed layout [0, N2R_PAYLOAD) is cleared whole as before.
   - The 8 KB payload tail is cleared only for draws with a texture-resource sidecar. The tail is read only through sidecar descriptors, which resources() packs there, and through an explicit sample-location record, which is written whole.
   - A draw without a sidecar that writes payload is refused (guard).
   - 16 KB -> 8 KB cleared per plain draw. Render oracle and bridge tests green.
3) compositor_submit.inc: tegu_shadow_job_has() caches, per job, whether any scanned slot holds a shadow-backed texture (Dispatch.shadowScan, a new last field).
   - tegu_shadow_jobs_any, tegu_shadow_refresh_handles and tegu_shadow_sync_jobs skip jobs without one.
   - Same selection (every selected texture is one), so the B2 seed check is unchanged.
   - The scans ran up to 6 times per command over 63 slots/job.
4) compositor_submit.inc tegu_jm_draw_batch_submit: per-thread reusable slot arena instead of calloc(run x 11632 B) per batch (~0.5 MB of fresh zeroed pages per 40-draw batch). Every slot field is written before use.

HOST MEASUREMENT (frame_bench, steady frames, lower-half mean; fit over 12 scenario/mode rows)

| state | per job | per draw | ca200 batched | large batched | blur_heavy batched |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C6q bridge | 1.48 us | 2.39 us | 518 us | 294 us | 159 us |
| + code compare | 1.31 us | 1.46 us | 332 us | 187 us | 90 us |
| + block clear | 1.13 us | 1.16 us | 263 us | 153 us | 78 us |
| + shadow scan / slot arena | 1.39 us | 0.81 us | 199 us | 129 us | 63 us |

- The per-job fit is noisy; the per-draw fit and the per-frame totals are robust.
- Device: not measured. The device's 0.27 ms/job + 0.153 ms/draw also contains kernel time. Items 1, 2 and 4 cut memory traffic (GPU-mapped reads, 8 KB of writes per draw, fresh page faults), which costs relatively more on 730 MHz cores than on the host.

md5: see the reply. NOT DONE: tegu_generic_v2_build_job still memsets and copies an 11.5 KB sidecar per draw (not handed over); next on the profile.
